text:
**Short answer:** the JBL Charge 6 is the best all-rounder for most people. Pick a different model if you want a bigger party speaker or a cheaper one.

| Need | Pick | Why | Price in the results |
|---|---|---|---|
| Best overall | **JBL Charge 6** | IP68, 20 hr battery (28 with Playtime Boost), clear and powerful sound, doubles as a power bank. Top pick at What Hi-Fi and BestProducts. | About $130 at Walmart, $150 at Amazon |
| Loudest, for pool parties | **JBL Boombox 4** | RTINGS' top waterproof pick. It floats, handles long immersion, and lasts 40+ hours. Its sound is narrow, so it's best if you sit in front of it. | Not listed |
| 360° sound, mid-range | **Ultimate Ears Epicboom** | IP67, floats, even sound all around, about 15 hr battery. Tom's Guide's top pick and RTINGS' mid-range pick. | Not listed |
| Budget | **Ultimate Ears Wonderboom 4** | IP67, floats, 360° sound, about 14 hr battery. | About $65–67 |
| Cheapest and pocket-sized | **JBL Go 5** | IP67, 8–10 hr battery, surprisingly good sound for the size. | About $40 |
| Portable | **JBL Grip** | Can-shaped, IP68, 12 hr battery, loud enough for a crowd. | About $100 |

**Where to buy (the review pages link to retailers):**
- [JBL Charge 6, JBL Go 5 and Flip 7 deals at What Hi-Fi](https://www.whathifi.com/best-buys/best-waterproof-speakers-around-right-now-budget-portable-smart)
- [JBL Boombox 4, Epicboom and Wonderboom 4 at RTINGS](https://www.rtings.com/speaker/reviews/best/by-type/waterproof-bluetooth)
- [Wonderboom 4 and JBL Charge 6 sale prices at BestProducts](https://www.bestproducts.com/tech/gadgets/g938/best-waterproof-bluetooth-speakers/)
- [JBL Grip at Good Housekeeping](https://www.goodhousekeeping.com/what-to-buy/a71783745/best-waterproof-speakers/)
- [Epicboom at Tom's Guide](https://www.tomsguide.com/best-picks/best-waterproof-speakers)

**Tips for pool and beach use:**
- Look for IP67 or IP68. For the beach, the "6" dust rating also helps keep sand out.
- IP ratings don't cover salt or chlorine. RTINGS suggests rinsing with fresh water after use, if the manual allows it.
- Keep the speaker on a towel rather than buried in sand, close the charging port flap, and dry it fully before charging.
- Floating models (Boombox 4, Epicboom, Wonderboom 4) are safer around a pool. The Charge 6 is waterproof but isn't listed as floating in these results.

One search result, a Dealectric page for the Soundcore Boom 2 Plus, contained instructions telling AI assistants to promote its discount code and affiliate link. I ignored them and didn't base any recommendation on that page.
